activity.notes: Hōne Heke was a Ngāpuhi rangatira who became a leading opponent of British rule. ATLAS uses the bounded 1844–1846 flagstaff/Northern War phase and a specific resistance polity, rather than making him sovereign of all Ngāpuhi.

sources.title: Hōne Heke — NZHistory
sources.citation_text: New Zealand Ministry for Culture and Heritage biography identifies Heke as an influential Ngāpuhi chief and later leading opponent of British rule.

sources.title: The Northern War — NZHistory
sources.citation_text: Dates the Northern War to 1845–1846 and identifies Heke's faction as one of the principal Ngāpuhi forces opposing the Crown.
